newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK Stock Exchange names Alec Tsui chief executive.
newsitem.headline: HK Stock Exchange names Alec Tsui chief executive.

text.p: The Stock Exchange of Hong Kong said on Wednesday it had named Alec Tsui as its new chief executive, effective February 1, 1997.
Tsui is now deputy chief executive of the exchange.
He will succeed Paul Chow, who has served as chief executive since 1991. Chow said in July he would retire on January 31, 1997.
Tsui said the exchange would follow the direction laid down by Chow.

"We will investigate and study in the coming few years, and the exchange will have many changes down the road," Tsui told a news conference. "We will have to face challenges and competition from...other international financial centres."
Tsui was named to a three-year term. He became deputy chief executive in January in charge of operation services, having joined the exchange in 1994.
